Attendance.label: Attendance Rate
Attendance.description: Percentage of classes attended during the academic semester.

Hours_Studied.label: Study Hours
Hours_Studied.description: Total independent study hours per week outside classroom instruction.

Previous_Scores.label: Previous Exam Score
Previous_Scores.description: Benchmark score achieved on the preceding qualification examination.

Access_to_Resources.label: Resource Access
Access_to_Resources.description: Availability of academic materials, textbooks, and laboratory equipment.

Parental_Involvement.label: Parental Involvement
Parental_Involvement.description: Engagement level of guardians in homework guidance and school communications.

Tutoring_Sessions.label: Tutoring Sessions
Tutoring_Sessions.description: Monthly one-on-one or small-group academic mentoring sessions attended.

Parental_Education_Level.label: Parental Education
Parental_Education_Level.description: Highest formal educational degree attained by the student's primary guardian.

Peer_Influence.label: Peer Influence
Peer_Influence.description: Academic orientation and study habits prevalent in peer study circle.

Distance_from_Home.label: Campus Distance
Distance_from_Home.description: Commute proximity between student residence and the educational institution.

Motivation_Level.label: Motivation Level
Motivation_Level.description: Student's self-reported academic ambition and commitment to milestones.

Teacher_Quality.label: Faculty Instruction Quality
Teacher_Quality.description: Assessed caliber of subject matter instruction and curriculum delivery.

Extracurricular_Activities.label: Extracurricular Participation
Extracurricular_Activities.description: Regular active involvement in athletic, cultural, or collegiate student clubs.

Internet_Access.label: Internet Connectivity
Internet_Access.description: Reliable high-speed broadband access at home for research and online assignments.
